name: rapidfuzz
description: Compare strings and rank candidate matches in DuckDB SQL using RapidFuzz. Find similar names, pick the best match from a list, match reordered words, or calculate edit distances.

cta.title: High-Performance Fuzzy Matching
cta.description: Install RapidFuzz for record linkage, dedupe, spell-check, and similarity ranking — Levenshtein with edit costs, Damerau-Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, WRatio and the full token ratio family, plus best-match extraction from a list, all from the Python rapidfuzz library.

quickStart.title: Find the closest name for each record
quickStart.description: Compare two input names with three candidates. Keep the highest-scoring candidate with a score of at least 80 for each input, using the candidate id to break ties.
quickStart.sql:
WITH names(id, name) AS (
  VALUES (1, 'Jon Smith'), (2, 'Jane Doe')
), candidates(id, name) AS (
  VALUES (10, 'John Smith'), (11, 'Jane Doe'), (12, 'Jon Smyth')
)
SELECT a.name AS input_name, b.name AS matched_name,
  round(rapidfuzz_ratio(a.name, b.name), 1) AS score
FROM names a CROSS JOIN candidates b
WHERE rapidfuzz_ratio(a.name, b.name) >= 80
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY a.id
  ORDER BY rapidfuzz_ratio(a.name, b.name) DESC, b.id
) = 1
ORDER BY a.id;
quickStart.note: A similarity score identifies a candidate, not a confirmed duplicate. This tiny example compares every pair. For larger tables, [reduce the candidate pairs before scoring](#blocking-strategies). Inputs with no score of at least 80 are omitted.

quickStart.title: Pick the best match from a list
quickStart.description: Map each customer name to the closest of three canonical company names, ignoring word order and repeated words.
quickStart.sql:
SELECT name,
  rapidfuzz_extract_one(name, ['Acme Corporation', 'Globex Industries', 'Initech'],
    scorer := 'token_set_ratio').choice AS canonical
FROM (VALUES ('ACME Corp.'), ('Globex Industires'), ('Initech LLC')) t(name);

introduction.title: Find candidate matches when text differs
paragraphs: Exact equality misses names with typing errors, changed word order, or small spelling differences. RapidFuzz adds similarity scores and edit distances to DuckDB so you can compare values and rank possible matches in SQL.

Use it for record linkage, reviewing possible duplicates, or matching input against a known list. A high score is evidence for a candidate, not proof of identity. For large tables, narrow the candidate pairs with a rule such as a shared postcode before scoring them.
